projects.name: Ascending the Mountain
projects.description: Four-stage limited-time project focused on high-altitude mechanics, ignition tests and landing capabilities. Late stages created heavy demand for Sensors, Broken Guidance Systems, Advanced Electrical Components and Vaporizer Regulators.
projects.rewardsNote: Guides agree on requirements. One guide lists the Rascal and Tempest rewards without a tier; the wiki lists them as Rascal IV and Tempest IV.
projects.datesNote: Ends 5 Oct 2026 (exact end hour not published in sources). Kept as a historical record after it closes.

projects.name: Trophy Display
projects.description: Use ARC parts to build a display of your hunting trophies, in order to not-so-subtly shut down anyone who questions the bold tales of your topside adventures.

stages.name: Roaming Threats
stages.description: The earthbound machines rolling and trudging across the surface, forcing Raiders to watch their every step.

stages.name: Soaring Menaces
stages.description: The airborne machines dominating the skies, raining peril down upon unsuspecting Raiders.

stages.name: Ferocious Foes
stages.description: A clear escalation of topside dangers, these machines have doled out severe punishments to overconfident Raiders.

stages.name: Dominant Dangers
stages.description: The vicious threats leaving behind a trail of downed Raiders; dominating their surroundings with tenacity and grit.

stages.name: Imposing Behemoths
stages.description: The colossal foes making the earth tremble, and the epitome of big-game hunting.

projects.name: Expedition Project (Expedition 1)
projects.description: Expeditions are perilous. Your Raider will carry all their possessions into the unknown beyond the Rust Belt. In return, your next Raider gains a unique edge that lasts until the next Expedition departs.

stages.name: Foundation
stages.description: Building the base structure and frame of the caravan

stages.name: Core Systems
stages.description: Connecting wiring, ventilation, and essential power systems

stages.name: Framework
stages.description: Building walls and roof, installing core systems, and defining the interior layout

stages.name: Outfitting
stages.description: Adding storage, workbenches, utilities, and personal touches

stages.name: Load Stage
stages.description: Loading the caravan with vital supplies. Combat gear, survival equipment, provisions, and repair materials are needed to fully prepare for the Expedition

stages.name: Departure
stages.description:
Your caravan is fully stocked and your Raider is ready to depart on the Expedition!

Upon departure, all items remaining in your Raider’s stash will be contributed to the Expedition, and your next Raider can earn up to five skill points based on the total value of those items.

projects.name: Flickering Flames
projects.description: A festival of resilient warmth, centered around the hardy candleberry bush. Speranzans have been known to host local celebrations, and being competitive, they seek to outdo each other at every turn. Some have managed to turn the homely candleberry bush into a banquet worthy of even the most discerning gourmands.

stages.name: Candlelight
stages.description: The namesake use for the candleberry, Speranzans boil the fruit into a thick wax that burns cleanly and fragrantly.

stages.name: Decorations
stages.description: Many Speranzans have become surprisingly adept at the art of bringing beauty and greenery into the home.

stages.name: Presents
stages.description: Crafty Speranzans have turned the candleberries into a wealth of gifts. These include perfumes and soaps, as well as gifts unrelated to the recipient's odors.

stages.name: Beverages
stages.description: Candleberries can be crushed into refreshing juices, while the leaves and roots make for a tea that can drive out the toughest of colds.

stages.name: Meals
stages.description: Though candleberry leaves are bitter, simmering them in stew and soups adds a touch of earthiness that nostalgic Speranzans have grown to love.

projects.name: Weather Monitor System
projects.description: Collect the required parts to build a private weather station, and help monitor the turbulent weather above.

stages.name: Atmospheric pressure
stages.description: Lets you measure if that heavy weight on your shoulders is actually just the air.

stages.name: Sunlight
stages.description: Sunlight might be sparse in Speranza, but ultraviolet rays can still be measured by the right equipment.

stages.name: Precipitation
stages.description: Very few parts of Speranza are completely waterproof. Now you can say it’s for science.

stages.name: Humidity
stages.description: Great for keeping your skin looking luminous, and your walls somewhat moldy.

stages.name: Temperature
stages.description: Significantly more accurate than counting shivers per minute.

projects.name: High-Gain Antenna
projects.description: When placed in open areas, these parabolic dishes can pick up on distant signals within a narrow beamwidth, which may help triangulate the origins of the troubling ARC signals that were recently reported.

stages.name: Sturdy Base
stages.description: An extra-sturdy base that can withstand anything from bitter winds to sudden cloudbursts.

stages.name: Data Logger
stages.description: A closed-circuit interface to monitor and analyze distributed data points over time.

stages.name: Parabolic Dish
stages.description: A custom-built parabolic dish designed to capture distant signals in even the most stormy of conditions.

projects.name: Converging Paths
projects.description: With ARC operations spreading across the Rust Belt, the nomads have agreed to share their knowledge in exchange for support. Raiders are needed to gather supplies, recover relics, and help secure safe passage for nomads traveling through dangerous routes.

stages.name: Secure Safe Passage for the Nomads
stages.description: Deal Damage to ARC enemies in the Swamp

stages.name: Collect Supplies
stages.description: Collect supplies to share with the nomads

stages.name: Procure Relics
stages.description: Find relics to share with the nomads

stages.name: Create Emergency Caches
stages.description: Build emergency caches to help both the nomads and Raiders stay alive on the surface

stages.name: Finish the Cabinet of Curiosities
stages.description: Put the finishing touches on the cabinet of curiosities, a new emblem of blossoming ties between the nomads and Speranza.

stages.name: Use Nomad Tactics to Fight ARC
stages.description: Deal damage to ARC using mines or traps (Blaze Grenade Trap, Pulse Mine, Jolt Mine, Explosive Mine, Surge Coil)

projects.name: Phantom Targets
projects.description: Unrecognizable noise has started flooding Shani's radars, and she can't pinpoint the origin of these phantom targets. Raider assistance is needed to improve antennas on the surface, and track ARC behavior for any changes.

stages.name: Test Multiple ARC Destruction Methods
